context.en-US: SIRT3 activation consistently correlates with reduced expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and MIP-2 (CXCL2), as well as diminished polymorphonuclear leukocyte infiltration in various preclinical models. These anti-inflammatory effects are sustained even after discontinuation of dietary interventions, indicating durable transcriptional reprogramming via NF-kappaB and STAT3 suppression.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 suppresses NLRP3 inflammasome formation and subsequent inflammatory responses by lowering mitochondrial ROS, a principal trigger of NLRP3 assembly and activation, and by inhibiting IkappaBalpha phosphorylation and modulating the NF-kappaB/TGF-beta1/Smad axis. SIRT3-knockout models show greater ROS accumulation, amplified NLRP3 oligomerization, and exacerbated mitochondrial structural abnormalities compared with wild-type controls. Because ROS and mitochondrial DNA released from damaged organelles prime the inflammasome, SIRT3 sits at the interface of mitochondrial redox and innate immune signaling, and its induction by fasting or pharmacological activation reduces inflammasome-driven inflammation.
context.zh-TW: SIRT3 與 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 一起，透過多種機制抑制 NF-kB 與 NLRP3 發炎體的活性。由於 sirtuins 依賴 NAD+，使用 NR 等前驅物提升 NAD+ 可增強此抑制作用。在人類周邊血單核細胞中，24 小時的 NR 投予重現了禁食效果，即透過 SIRT3 依賴的方式抑制 NLRP3 發炎體活化並增強粒線體品質控制，進而減少 IL-1beta 與 TNF-alpha 的分泌。這種由 sirtuin 介導的 NLRP3 發炎體抑制，有助於在嚴重感染中預防細胞激素風暴，並減緩與老化和代謝疾病相關的慢性發炎。

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 regulates autophagic flux through the AMPK/mTOR and FOXO3a pathways, facilitating mitochondrial quality control via AMPK/ULK1 phosphorylation while antagonizing mTOR-mediated autophagic repression. Genetic ablation of SIRT3 impairs autophagic signaling with paradoxical activation of glutathione peroxidase 4 activity that suppresses autophagy initiation. A positive feedback loop exists in which autophagy induces SIRT3 via FOXO3a, restoring hematopoietic stem cell repopulation through enhanced clearance of damaged mitochondria.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 promotes PINK1/Parkin-mediated mitophagy, which reduces mitochondrial ROS and restores hematopoietic stem cell repopulation efficiency through lysosomal clearance of damaged mitochondria. In the aging brain, the PINK1/Parkin pathway clears damaged mitochondria in Alzheimer's disease models, mitigating amyloidogenesis and tau pathology, and in osteoarthritis models SIRT3 promotes mitophagy to maintain chondrocyte health. Mitophagy is thus a core mitochondrial quality-control arm of SIRT3's cytoprotective program.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: In Alzheimer's disease, SIRT3 enhances mitochondrial bioenergetics disrupted by amyloid-beta toxicity, partially through deacetylation of mitochondrial p53 at Lys320, a modification crucial for maintaining energy homeostasis and neuronal survival. SIRT3 mRNA expression declines progressively in AD clinical specimens and rodent models, and SIRT3 levels inversely associate with tau protein deposition, supporting SIRT3 as a mitochondrial checkpoint and candidate biomarker in AD.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: In Parkinson's disease, SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of dynamin-related protein 1 (DRP1), a mitochondrial fission protein implicated in pathological fragmentation, restores mitochondrial dynamics, protects against dopaminergic neuronal loss, and ameliorates motor deficits in murine models. SIRT3 concurrently scavenges ROS, preserves electron transport chain integrity, and promotes mitochondrial autophagy, attenuating neurodegeneration in midbrain dopaminergic populations.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 governs mitochondrial biogenesis by activating PGC-1alpha transcriptional programs, which maintain mitochondrial DNA integrity in Parkinson's disease models, and promotes PGC-1alpha-dependent transcription to sustain redox homeostasis and neuronal energy metabolism in Huntington's disease. In diabetic nephropathy, the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis activated by meteorin-like protein stimulates AMPK at Thr172 and UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructure.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Beyond mitochondrial homeostasis, SIRT3 contributes to the clearance of misfolded alpha-synuclein aggregates, a pathological hallmark of Parkinson's disease, and mitigates neuroinflammation by suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome activation. These converging actions highlight the translational potential of targeting SIRT3 in PD therapy, though whether SIRT3 alterations precede dopaminergic neurodegeneration remains unclear.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Pharmacological potentiation of SIRT3 by nicotinamide (NAM) preserves neuronal ultrastructural integrity and viability in ALS models, and SIRT3 overexpression in mutant SOD1 (G93A) ALS models ameliorates disease phenotypes. Loss of SIRT3 activity promotes aberrant mitochondrial protein hyperacetylation, compromising OXPHOS complex stoichiometry and electron transport chain capacity in ALS pathogenesis.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: In Huntington's disease, SIRT3 maintains mitochondrial dynamics by suppressing fission regulators such as Fis1 and Drp1, preserving mitochondrial morphology and promoting efficient axonal transport. In Drosophila HD models, transgenic expression of the SIRT3 ortholog dSirt2 significantly attenuates neuropil degeneration and prolongs organismal longevity, reinforcing conserved neuroprotective functions of SIRT3 across species.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Chronic hyperglycemia suppresses SIRT3 expression in the hippocampus, contributing to cognitive deficits through mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and neuronal apoptosis. SIRT3 overexpression mitigates neuronal injury by inhibiting the VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex, thereby reducing mitochondria-associated endoplasmic reticulum membrane (MAM) formation and protecting neurons from metabolic stress-induced apoptosis in diabetic encephalopathy.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: In diabetic periodontitis models, irisin exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects that are strictly dependent on SIRT3: lentivirus-mediated SIRT3 silencing abolishes irisin's osteoprotective efficacy against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction. SIRT3 is therefore the obligatory signaling node for irisin-mediated redox homeostasis and bone preservation in the diabetic periodontium.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: In chronic lymphocytic leukemia, SIRT3 enables metabolic adaptation that confers chemoresistance via ROS buffering. This tumor-supportive role contrasts with SIRT3's tumor-suppressive actions in other contexts (Warburg suppression via HIF-1alpha destabilization, OGG1-mediated DNA repair, H3K56 deacetylation for NHEJ fidelity), exemplifying the dualistic, context-dependent behavior of SIRT3 in cancer biology.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 destabilizes hypoxia-inducible factor 1alpha (HIF-1alpha), thereby attenuating the Warburg effect, a characteristic metabolic adaptation of rapidly proliferating tumors. Transcriptomic profiling in castration-resistant prostate cancer reveals that SIRT3 also suppresses aconitase 2 activation, disrupting glutamine-driven lipogenesis, supporting SIRT3's predominantly tumor-suppressive metabolic role in early oncogenic transformation.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 is a pivotal coordinator of renal bioenergetics maintaining mitochondrial homeostasis, enhancing antioxidant defenses, and modulating ECM dynamics; its expression is reduced across nephropathies and negatively correlated with histological injury severity. SIRT3 overexpression alleviates AKI and CKD progression in multiple preclinical models, via Nrf2 pathway upregulation, NF-kappaB suppression through IkappaBalpha stabilization, and inhibition of NLRP3 inflammasome activation.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Pharmacological AMPK activation using metformin promotes SENP1-mediated deSUMOylation of SIRT3, enhancing its mitochondrial localization and functional activity, which in turn reduces tubular cell apoptosis under metabolic stress in AKI models. The AMPK/SENP1/SIRT3 axis also governs mitochondrial apoptosis via SOD2 deacetylation, mitigating oxidative stress-induced apoptosis across renal and other tissues.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Within the tubular epithelium, SIRT3 suppresses epithelial-mesenchymal transformation (EMT) through activation of FOXO3a, which directly induces mitochondrial SOD2 and peroxisomal catalase expression. This coordinated antioxidant enzyme induction mitigates intracellular oxidative stress, preventing ECM component deposition associated with early fibrotic lesions, and SIRT3 also disrupts the NF-kappaB/TGF-beta1/Smad axis that drives fibrogenesis.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 deacetylates beta-catenin, a pivotal transcriptional coactivator in fibroblast activation, facilitating the expression of MMP-7 and plasminogen activator inhibitor-1, two mediators implicated in ECM remodeling via EMT induction. In CKD, this complements SIRT3's FOXO3a-dependent EMT suppression. Independently, poricoic acid A upregulates SIRT3 and promotes beta-catenin K49 deacetylation to attenuate renal fibroblast activation and interstitial fibrosis.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: A regulatory axis exists in which soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH) modulates SIRT3 turnover via proteolytic degradation, with sEH deficiency preserving SIRT3 bioavailability to fulfill bioenergetic demands and impede renal vascular calcification progression. sEH inhibition or deficiency therefore acts as an indirect SIRT3-stabilizing strategy in advanced CKD-associated vascular calcification.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Caloric restriction alleviates age-related hearing loss by reducing oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protective effect is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice, highlighting SIRT3's indispensable role in CR-induced auditory resilience. Mechanistically, SIRT3 enhances IDH2 activity under CR, boosting mitochondrial NADPH production and ROS clearance, preserving cochlear hair cell integrity and delaying hearing loss progression.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Oxidative stress-induced upregulation of microRNA-494-3p leads to decreased SIRT3 levels, establishing a feedback loop that further exacerbates senescence. In COPD, miR-494-3p directly targets SIRT3 in small airway epithelial cells, leading to SIRT3 downregulation, increased p27 expression, and accelerated cellular senescence contributing to COPD pathophysiology.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Honokiol (HKL), a bisphenolic lignan from Magnolia officinalis, upregulates SIRT3 while augmenting its enzymatic activity, and shRNA-induced SIRT3 knockdown significantly attenuates HKL's cytoprotective effects on mitochondrial biogenesis, OXPHOS capacity, and bioenergetic output. HKL protects the brain from ischemia-reperfusion injury, ameliorates intracerebral hemorrhage-induced apoptosis and mitochondrial fission, and inhibits ferroptosis, all via SIRT3 activation.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Resveratrol (RSV) significantly diminishes mtROS generation by enhancing SIRT3 accumulation within mitochondria, which upregulates FOXO3A-dependent transcription of mitochondrial genes (ATP6, CO1, Cytb, ND2, ND5), improving complex I activity and ATP synthesis. RSV also enhances SIRT3 transcription through ERRalpha-dependent transcription via the AMPK/PGC-1alpha/ERRalpha/SIRT3 signaling cascade, with benefits abrogated by AMPK inhibition or SIRT3 siRNA.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Melatonin upregulates SIRT3, which promotes mitophagy to mitigate oxidative stress-induced damage, and SIRT3 knockout completely abolishes melatonin's benefits against contrast-induced AKI. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin promotes autophagy, reduces apoptosis, and mitigates mitochondrial dysfunction by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, with SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of TFAM at Lys154 acting as a pivotal molecular switch for mitophagic flux.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: 2-APQC (2-acetylphenolquinone congener) is a novel pharmacological agonist of SIRT3 that significantly alleviates isoproterenol-induced pathological cardiac hypertrophy and fibrotic progression, with efficacy completely lost in SIRT3-knockout models and markedly attenuated by the SIRT3 inhibitor nicotinamide, confirming SIRT3 as its primary molecular target. Mechanistically it suppresses AKT/mTOR/p70S6K and JNK/TGF-beta/Smad3 signaling.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: The licorice-derived compound liquiritigenin induces Nrf2 translocation, thereby potentiating SIRT3 activity and facilitating mitochondrial biogenesis while simultaneously suppressing apoptosis in acute kidney injury models. This dual action mitigates oxidative stress injury and cell death, highlighting liquiritigenin's therapeutic value in AKI and related redox-driven pathologies.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Poria cocos-derived poricoic acid A upregulates SIRT3 and promotes beta-catenin K49 deacetylation, effectively attenuating renal fibroblast activation and renal interstitial fibrosis in vivo and in vitro. The compound thereby exemplifies phytochemical engagement of the SIRT3-beta-catenin axis as a disease-modifying strategy for tubulointerstitial fibrosis in chronic kidney disease.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Stanniocalcin-1, a glycoprotein hormone, orchestrates a hormetic AMPK/SIRT3 axis that mitigates oxidative stress and apoptosis, and inhibits BNIP3 expression through the AMPK/SIRT3 pathway to ameliorate renal injury in diabetic murine models. The hormetic description reflects STC1's pattern of effect: mild mitochondrial stress engages AMPK, supporting SIRT3-dependent mitochondrial quality control.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Intermedin (adrenomedullin 2) enhances mitochondrial bioenergetic capacity via AMPK/SIRT3-mediated cristae remodeling in vascular calcification models. Because vascular calcification, a hallmark of advanced CKD, is driven by mitochondrial dysfunction and osteogenic transdifferentiation of vascular smooth muscle cells, intermedin's SIRT3-dependent improvement of cristae architecture opposes the calcific phenotype.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Meteorin-like protein activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, which stimulates AMPK at Thr172 and increases UCP1-dependent proton leak, thereby preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism, particularly in diabetic nephropathy. The cascade links an exercise-induced myokine to mitochondrial quality control through the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3/AMPK/UCP1 pathway.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: The annexin A1-derived tripeptide Ac2-26 transcriptionally upregulates SIRT3, concurrently reducing oxidative damage while promoting mitochondrial biogenesis and mitophagy. In models of ischemic kidney injury, Ac2-26 increases SIRT3 and augments mitochondrial function to limit injury, linking pro-resolving inflammation biology to mitochondrial quality control.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: In diabetic cardiomyopathy, SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity and suppresses oxidative stress primarily through modulation of the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway, uncoupling excessive glucose levels from electron transport chain dysfunction. SIRT3 downregulation leads to breakdown of this axis, resulting in impaired ETC activity and accelerated DCM progression.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Lactate can downregulate SIRT3, which in turn increases acyl-CoA synthetase long chain family member 4 (ACSL4) lactylation, thereby promoting ferroptosis and accelerating the decline of nucleus pulposus cell functionality in intervertebral disc degeneration. This cascade connects disc metabolic dysregulation (hypoxia, lactate accumulation) to SIRT3 loss and ferroptotic cell death via the lactylation mark.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: In hepatic fibrosis models, SIRT3 has been implicated in mediating the anti-fibrotic effects of withaferin A, an effect that is abolished in SIRT3-knockout mice. This finding reinforces SIRT3's role as an indispensable molecular effector of pharmacological anti-fibrotic agents, consistent with its central suppressive function across hepatic, pulmonary, cardiac, and renal fibrosis models.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Melatonin's orchestration of sequential mitophagy processes depends on SIRT3-mediated deacetylation of TFAM at Lys154, the pivotal molecular switch promoting mitophagic flux. In vascular calcification, SIRT3 also deacetylates proteins within the PGC-1alpha/TFAM pathway, promoting mitochondrial biogenesis while attenuating vascular smooth muscle cell calcification.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Chronic hyperglycemia suppresses SIRT3 expression in the hippocampus, contributing to cognitive deficits through mitochondrial Ca2+ overload and neuronal apoptosis. SIRT3 is also consistently downregulated in clinical diabetic tissues, where its deficiency correlates with insulin resistance, and in skeletal muscle its deficiency impairs insulin-stimulated glucose translocation, aggravating peripheral insulin resistance in type 2 diabetes.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 counteracts vascular calcification via mitochondrial function preservation and oxidative stress mitigation, deacetylating proteins in the PGC-1alpha/TFAM pathway to promote mitochondrial biogenesis while attenuating vascular smooth muscle cell calcification. AMPK/SIRT3 axis activation attenuated mineralization through mitochondrial functional restoration, and sEH deficiency preserves SIRT3 bioavailability to impede VC progression.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 overexpression significantly mitigates cardiac hypertrophy and fibrosis in preclinical models, whereas SIRT3 deficiency promotes hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and progressive ventricular dysfunction. Honokiol ameliorates pre-existing cardiac hypertrophy and suppresses SIRT3-dependent cardiac fibroblast proliferation, and 2-APQC alleviates isoproterenol-induced pathological hypertrophy in a SIRT3-dependent causal manner confirmed by knockout models.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 contributes to maintaining mitochondrial morphology through optic atrophy 1 (OPA1) deacetylation, maintaining cristae structure and preventing inflammasome activation in cardiac fibroblasts. Matrine engages protective effects against cisplatin-induced AKI by modulating mitochondrial membrane dynamics through the SIRT3/OPA1 pathway, combining antioxidant and anti-inflammatory mechanisms to preserve renal function.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 regulates pyruvate dehydrogenase E1alpha deacetylation, bridging glycolysis and the TCA cycle in tubular epithelial cells during the progression of renal fibrosis. Honokiol-activated SIRT3 upregulates mitochondrial GPX4 and decreases its acetylation, inhibiting neuronal ferroptosis and mitigating perioperative neurocognitive disorders, illustrating SIRT3's metabolic-enzyme control across glycolysis-TCA coupling.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: Epigenetic modifications can impair SIRT3 function, such as through SUMOylation-mediated inhibition, exacerbating mitochondrial dysfunction and cartilage degeneration in osteoarthritis. SENP1-mediated deSUMOylation of SIRT3 (promoted by AMPK activation with metformin) enhances its mitochondrial localization and functional activity, reducing tubular cell apoptosis under metabolic stress.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: In osteoarthritis, SIRT3 preserves mitochondrial integrity by deacetylating cytochrome c oxidase subunit 4 isoform 2, and its deletion correlates with OA exacerbation in animal and human models. SIRT3 promotes mitophagy via the PINK1/Parkin axis, maintains mitochondrial health by regulating FOXO3a hyperacetylation, inhibits chondrocyte apoptosis through PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling, facilitates mitochondrial fusion for mtDNA complementation, and enhances cartilage resilience.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 expression is significantly reduced in degenerated intervertebral discs, and its knockdown further exacerbates deterioration of nucleus pulposus cells under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis, while SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo, and hydrogel microspheres upregulating both SIRT3 and SOD2 maintain NPC viability.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 is critical in maintaining mitochondrial homeostasis and counteracting oxidative stress in COPD, where the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 pathway is pivotal for mitochondrial biogenesis and redox equilibrium. SIRT3 deficiency exacerbates alveolar destruction, increases airway inflammation, and accelerates pulmonary function decline; miR-494-3p targeting of SIRT3 in small airway epithelial cells accelerates senescence contributing to COPD pathophysiology.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 strengthens mitochondrial function by deacetylating key metabolic enzymes such as SOD2 and IDH2, optimizing TCA cycle efficiency and preserving cardiomyocyte viability under stress, particularly in hypertensive heart failure models. SIRT3 protects cardiomyocytes by modulating ROS levels, oxidative phosphorylation, and Ku70 expression, and suppresses pathological hypertrophy and apoptotic signaling via mitochondrial quality control through PINK1-mediated autophagic pathways.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: The conclusion of the review positions SIRT3 as a pleiotropic regulatory hub in cellular senescence and geropathology, a critical determinant across cardiovascular diseases, neurodegenerative conditions, metabolic syndrome, cancer, kidney diseases, COPD, and degenerative spine and joint diseases. It highlights SIRT3's regulation of the mitochondrial acetylome and its profound effect on chromatin remodeling and genome stability, making SIRT3 agonism a promising translational strategy in geroscience.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: SIRT3

context.en-US: SIRT3 exerts context-dependent roles in cancer: as a tumor suppressor it stabilizes chromosomal integrity via OGG1-mediated DNA repair potentiation, facilitates H3K56 deacetylation for NHEJ fidelity, destabilizes HIF-1alpha to attenuate the Warburg effect, and deacetylates IDH2 at K143 to suppress ROS-mediated mutagenesis. Yet it can be oncogenic (pyroline-5-carboxylate reductase 1 Lys228, SHMT2 Lys95, glycine decarboxylase Lys514 deacetylation) and enables chemoresistance in CLL via ROS buffering.

source_document: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md

subject: Histone Crotonylation

context.en-US: Histone crotonylation (Kcr) is deposited from crotonyl-CoA and generally marks active transcription. SIRT3 possesses substantial lysine decrotonylase capacity, selectively removing crotonyl groups from specific histone substrates, and decreases H3K27 crotonylation at metastasis-associated loci such as ETS1 to constrain neoplastic dissemination.

source_document: Histone Crotonylation.md

subject: ETS1

context.en-US: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at the ETS1 promoter, constraining neoplastic dissemination. The lncRNA LINC00922 decoys SIRT3 from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis (Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023).

source_document: ETS1.md

subject: FOS

context.en-US: FOS (c-Fos) is an immediate-early bZIP transcription factor that heterodimerizes with JUN family members to form AP-1 complexes regulating proliferation, inflammation, and matrix remodeling genes. SIRT3 attenuates fibrosis in cardiomyocytes by inhibiting FOS/AP-1 (and STAT3/NFATc2) signaling, restraining pathological cardiac remodeling.

source_document: FOS.md

subject: Succinate Dehydrogenase

context.en-US: Succinate dehydrogenase (complex II) couples the TCA cycle to the electron transport chain. The review identifies SDH as a critical acetylation node in the mitochondrial matrix regulated by SIRT3, mediating crosstalk between metabolic flux control and mitochondrial energy transduction, fine-tuning substrate utilization and electron transfer synchronization.

source_document: Succinate Dehydrogenase.md

subject: MIP-2

context.en-US: MIP-2 (CXCL2) is a CXC chemokine recruiting neutrophils via CXCR2. SIRT3 activation consistently correlates with reduced MIP-2 expression alongside TNF-alpha and IL-6, and diminished polymorphonuclear leukocyte infiltration in preclinical models, via NF-kappaB suppression.

source_document: MIP-2.md

subject: Withaferin A

context.en-US: Withaferin A, a withanolide from Withania somnifera, mediates anti-fibrotic effects in hepatic fibrosis models through SIRT3; this effect is abolished in SIRT3-knockout mice, positioning SIRT3 as the indispensable molecular effector of this pharmacological anti-fibrotic agent.

source_document: Withaferin A.md

subject: Irisin

context.en-US: Irisin, the exercise-induced FNDC5 cleavage product, exerts antioxidative and osteoprotective effects in diabetic periodontitis models that require SIRT3: lentiviral SIRT3 silencing abolishes its protection against osteoclastic alveolar bone resorption and ROS overproduction, establishing SIRT3 as the obligatory signaling node.

source_document: Irisin.md

subject: Periodontitis

context.en-US: Periodontitis is a chronic inflammatory disease of tooth-supporting tissues driven by dysbiotic biofilm and host responses, with diabetes as a major risk modifier. In diabetic periodontitis models, irisin's SIRT3-dependent osteoprotection prevents alveolar bone resorption, identifying SIRT3 as a host-modulatory target.

source_document: Periodontitis.md

subject: GRP75

context.en-US: GRP75 (mortalin/HSPA9) links the ER IP3R to the mitochondrial VDAC1 channel at mitochondria-associated ER membranes, gating calcium transfer. SIRT3 overexpression inhibits the VDAC1/GRP75/IP3R complex, reducing MAM formation and protecting hippocampal neurons from hyperglycemia-induced mitochondrial calcium overload and apoptosis.

source_document: GRP75.md

subject: Indole-3-propionic acid

context.en-US: Indole-3-propionic acid is a gut microbiota-derived tryptophan metabolite. It potentiates SIRT3 to enhance myocardial bioenergetics and improve diastolic function in heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, representing a microbiota-mitochondria axis with translational potential.

source_document: Indole-3-propionic acid.md

subject: COL1A1

context.en-US: COL1A1 encodes the alpha-1 chain of type I collagen, the principal ECM fibrillar collagen in myocardium. SIRT3 suppresses myocardial fibrosis through deacetylation of pro-fibrotic genes including COL1A1 and TGF-beta1, reducing ECM deposition in pressure-overloaded cardiomyocytes.

source_document: COL1A1.md

subject: MMP-7

context.en-US: MMP-7 (matrilysin) is a secreted metalloproteinase that degrades ECM components and mediates EMT and tissue remodeling. SIRT3 deacetylates beta-catenin, influencing MMP-7 and PAI-1 expression, two mediators implicated in ECM remodeling via EMT induction in renal fibrosis.

source_document: MMP-7.md

subject: NADPH oxidase

context.en-US: NADPH oxidase (NOX) enzymes generate superoxide as their primary product and are a major pathological ROS source in the kidney. In angiotensin II-induced nephropathy, SIRT3 counteracts iron overload and inhibits NADPH oxidase-mediated ROS overproduction, attenuating renal fibrogenesis and delaying CKD progression.

source_document: NADPH oxidase.md

subject: soluble epoxide hydrolase

context.en-US: Soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH/EPHX2) hydrolyzes epoxy-fatty acids and modulates SIRT3 turnover via proteolytic degradation. sEH deficiency preserves SIRT3 bioavailability to fulfill bioenergetic demands and impedes renal vascular calcification progression, linking lipid-epoxide biology to SIRT3 stability.

source_document: soluble epoxide hydrolase.md

subject: Hair Cells

context.en-US: Cochlear hair cells are mechanosensory receptors that cannot regenerate once lost. Under caloric restriction, SIRT3-driven IDH2 activation boosts mitochondrial NADPH and ROS clearance, preserving cochlear hair cell integrity — protection completely lost in SIRT3-deficient mice.

source_document: Hair Cells.md

subject: Cochlea

context.en-US: The cochlea is the auditory organ where cumulative oxidative damage drives age-related hearing loss. Caloric restriction reduces oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protection is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice, making SIRT3 indispensable for CR-induced auditory resilience and a candidate therapeutic target in AHL.

source_document: Cochlea.md

subject: Mst1

context.en-US: Mst1 (STK4) is a Hippo-pathway kinase that promotes apoptosis and suppresses protective autophagy. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin counteracts adverse left-ventricle remodeling by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, promoting autophagy, reducing apoptosis, and mitigating mitochondrial dysfunction.

source_document: Mst1.md

subject: Silybin

context.en-US: Silybin is the principal flavonolignan of milk thistle. It attenuates cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity by preserving renal tubular integrity and mitochondrial bioenergetics, likely via SIRT3-mediated mechanisms, placing it among natural compounds engaging the mitochondrial deacetylase axis in kidney injury.

source_document: Silybin.md

subject: Matrine

context.en-US: Matrine is a quinolizidine alkaloid from Sophora flavescens. It protects against cisplatin-induced AKI by modulating mitochondrial membrane dynamics through the SIRT3/OPA1 pathway and confers cardiovascular benefits via the SIRT3/AMPK pathway, preserving cardiomyocyte viability and limiting cell death.

source_document: Matrine.md

subject: Liquiritigenin

context.en-US: Liquiritigenin is a licorice-derived flavanone that induces Nrf2 translocation, thereby potentiating SIRT3 activity and facilitating mitochondrial biogenesis while suppressing apoptosis in acute kidney injury models, mitigating oxidative stress injury and cell death.

source_document: Liquiritigenin.md

subject: Poricoic acid A

context.en-US: Poricoic acid A is a lanostane triterpenoid from Poria cocos. It upregulates SIRT3 and promotes beta-catenin K49 deacetylation, attenuating renal fibroblast activation and renal interstitial fibrosis in vivo and in vitro, a candidate disease-modifying agent for tubulointerstitial fibrosis.

source_document: Poricoic acid A.md

subject: Stanniocalcin-1

context.en-US: Stanniocalcin-1 is a glycoprotein hormone orchestrating a hormetic AMPK/SIRT3 axis that mitigates oxidative stress and apoptosis. It inhibits BNIP3 expression through the AMPK/SIRT3 pathway, ameliorating renal injury in diabetic murine models.

source_document: Stanniocalcin-1.md

subject: Intermedin

context.en-US: Intermedin (adrenomedullin 2) enhances mitochondrial bioenergetic capacity via AMPK/SIRT3-mediated cristae remodeling in vascular calcification models, opposing the calcific phenotype driven by mitochondrial dysfunction in advanced chronic kidney disease.

source_document: Intermedin.md

subject: Meteorin-like protein

context.en-US: Meteorin-like (Metrnl) activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, stimulating AMPK at Thr172 and increasing UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism in diabetic nephropathy.

source_document: Meteorin-like.md

subject: Ac2-26

context.en-US: Ac2-26, the annexin A1-derived tripeptide mimetic, transcriptionally upregulates SIRT3, concurrently reducing oxidative damage while promoting mitochondrial biogenesis and mitophagy, augmenting mitochondrial function to limit ischemic kidney injury (Suliman et al., Front Physiol 2021).

source_document: Annexin A1.md

subject: DNA Ligase IV

context.en-US: DNA ligase IV (LIG4) catalyzes the final phosphodiester-bond sealing step of non-homologous end joining with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 promotes NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation and interacts with DNA repair proteins including DNA ligase 4 to repair mtDNA damage.

source_document: DNA Ligase IV.md

subject: lncRNA DACH1

context.en-US: A long noncoding RNA at the DACH1 locus interacts with SIRT3 to regulate mitochondrial oxidative damage and cell death in heart failure, representing a noncoding-RNA arm of SIRT3's cardioprotective network that couples nuclear gene regulation to mitochondrial integrity.

source_document: DACH1.md

subject: miR-494-3p

context.en-US: Oxidative stress-induced miR-494-3p downregulates SIRT3, establishing a senescence-exacerbating feedback loop; in COPD it directly targets SIRT3 in small airway epithelial cells, increasing p27 expression and accelerating cellular senescence.

source_document: miR-494-3p.md

subject: Lactylation

context.en-US: Lysine lactylation is a lactate-derived post-translational modification coupling metabolic state to protein function. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation, promoting ferroptosis and accelerating nucleus pulposus cell decline in intervertebral disc degeneration.

source_document: Lactylation.md

subject: AGO2

context.en-US: AGO2 (Argonaute 2) is the catalytic core of RISC executing microRNA-guided silencing. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity through modulation of the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway; SIRT3 loss breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression.

source_document: AGO2.md

subject: Type 2 Diabetes

context.en-US: SIRT3 is consistently downregulated in clinical diabetic tissues, with deficiency correlating with insulin resistance and disturbed systemic energy homeostasis. In skeletal muscle, SIRT3 deficiency impairs insulin-stimulated glucose translocation, aggravating peripheral insulin resistance and contributing to type 2 diabetes pathophysiology.

source_document: Type 2 Diabetes.md

subject: Diabetic Cardiomyopathy

context.en-US: SIRT3 activation improves mitochondrial respiratory capacity and suppresses oxidative stress in DCM primarily through the AGO2/cytochrome b (CYTB) signaling pathway. SIRT3 downregulation breaks this axis, impairing ETC activity and accelerating DCM progression; melatonin protects via Mst1 inhibition and SIRT3 upregulation.

source_document: Diabetic Cardiomyopathy.md

subject: Non-homologous End Joining

context.en-US: NHEJ directly ligates DNA double-strand breaks without a homologous template; DNA ligase IV performs the terminal sealing with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 enhances NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation, supporting genome stability and mtDNA repair.

source_document: Non-homologous End Joining.md

subject: Nucleus Pulposus

context.en-US: Nucleus pulposus cells decline in intervertebral disc degeneration, exacerbated by SIRT3 knockdown under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis that accelerates NPC functional decline; SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo.

source_document: Nucleus Pulposus.md

subject: SENP1

context.en-US: SENP1 is the SUMO-specific protease that removes SUMO from conjugated substrates. AMPK activation with metformin promotes SENP1-mediated deSUMOylation of SIRT3, enhancing its mitochondrial localization and functional activity, reducing tubular cell apoptosis under metabolic stress in AKI models.

source_document: SENP1.md

subject: 2-APQC

context.en-US: 2-APQC is a novel pharmacological agonist of SIRT3 that alleviates isoproterenol-induced pathological cardiac hypertrophy and fibrosis; efficacy is lost in SIRT3-knockout models and attenuated by nicotinamide, confirming SIRT3 as its primary target, via suppression of AKT/mTOR/p70S6K and JNK/TGF-beta/Smad3 signaling.

source_document: 2-APQC.md

subject: Age-related Hearing Loss

context.en-US: AHL is the most prevalent auditory impairment in older adults, tightly correlated with cumulative oxidative stress. Caloric restriction alleviates AHL by reducing oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protection is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice; SIRT3-driven IDH2/NADPH activity preserves cochlear hair cells.

source_document: Age-related Hearing Loss.md
